title: Human Ear and Organ of Corti
alt: Lettered schematic: Human Ear and Organ of Corti
source: Supplied Biology30_Labeling_Package_with_Answers.zip; textbook comparison documented in metadata
legend: Detailed cochlear chambers: L, scala vestibuli, is the upper vestibular canal; M, scala media, is the middle cochlear duct containing endolymph and the organ of Corti; R, scala tympani, is the lower tympanic canal. The upper and lower canals contain perilymph. The round window (S) is a membrane at the base of the cochlea that allows pressure displacement; it is not the lower wall of this enlarged cross-section.
reviewNote: The oval window receives the stapes vibration. The round window is at the cochlear base, not on the wall of the enlarged inset.
